description: This file defines a React component and a provider class for searching channels with permission checks in a Mattermost web application. It includes UI rendering, channel filtering, sorting, and server data fetching.

classes.name: SearchChannelWithPermissionsProvider
classes.description: A provider class that manages channel search with permission filtering and server data fetching.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the provider with a channel search function.

methods.name: makeChannelSearchFilter
methods.description: Creates a filter function for channels based on permissions and prefix.

methods.name: handlePretextChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in search input, triggers local filtering and server fetch.

methods.name: fetchChannels
methods.description: Fetches channels from server asynchronously and updates results.

methods.name: formatChannelsAndDispatch
methods.description: Filters, sorts, and dispatches channel suggestions based on search prefix.
